During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''uprising''' took place in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==The uprising==
The uprising started after the defection of [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] veteran [[Aron Onstall]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The defection of the famous hotshot [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] created a very public uprising in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]], and a public relations nightmare for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SoT" />
